title: Evaluation compatibility of the specified intrinsic inverse-image clopen word
statement: For any inverse ring system C with transitions τ and n∈ℕ, let E_n be evaluation followed by the constant diagram and exact localization, with the comparisons evalP and evalJ of [def-sf-semilinear-evaluation-normalization-data]. For any commutative proper/open square k:V→W, r:V→S, p:W→T, i:S→T with k,i quasi-compact open and r,p proper, and every M in D(S), the exact inverse-image word alpha satisfies E_{n,W}(alpha_Q(M)); evalJ_k(P_r M); J_k^{C_n}(evalP_r(M)) = evalP_p(J_i M); G_p^{C_n}(evalJ_i(M)); alpha_Q^{C_n}(E_{n,S} M). Semicolons mean composition in written order. This concerns the specified exact inverse-image/open-extension maps and the clopen word, before any proper-adjunction mate; no faithfulness of evaluation on derived morphisms is assumed.

proof.text: Use [lem-sp-varying-ring-clopen-arrow-evaluation] for the canonical single-level alpha word. At the ordinary level, the support module identifies the chosen evalPullInv with the constant-diagram lift of the section-normalized moduleEvalG. This follows by comparing the chosen direct-image comparison on every section, and transposing its unit square. The same normalization fixes the inverse-image and open compositors.

Evaluation of ordinary beta has the same open-unit transpose as single-level beta. Evaluation of the clopen projector is the identity on the selected factor and zero on its complement; the constant diagonal preserves both maps. Thus the full ordinary beta/projector/compositor word is the constant lift of the same single-level word. This is also valid for empty components and for noncartesian proper/open squares, because only the chosen square lift is clopen.

Localize the equality of ordinary constant-diagram words, using exact-derived transformation pasting and the intrinsic/varying-ring pre-mate alpha normalization. Exact localization of the normalized inverse-image square is evalP by definition. The inverse open-mate localization theorem identifies the localized open comparison with the specified evalJ. Insert these identifications; naturality and cancellation of the exact-composition isomorphisms give the displayed equation on whole derived systems. This constructs the equality before evaluation of derived morphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem intrinsicEvaluationAlphaCompatibility
    {V W S T : Scheme.{u}} (k : V ⟶ W) (r : V ⟶ S) (p : W ⟶ T) (i : S ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i]
    [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (M : Derived C τ S) :
    (E C τ n W).map ((alpha C τ k r p i h).app M) ≫
        (evalJ C τ n k).hom.app ((P C τ r).obj M) ≫
        (StrictTower.J (C n) k).map ((evalP C τ n r).hom.app M) =
      (evalP C τ n p).hom.app ((J C τ i).obj M) ≫
        (StrictTower.G (C n) p).map ((evalJ C τ n i).hom.app M) ≫
        (StrictTower.alpha (C n) k r p i h).app ((E C τ n S).obj M)
